# `charset`

Byte-order mark handling. preserve keeps whatever the file arrived with.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `utf-8` |  |
| `utf-8-bom` |  |
| `preserve` |  |

**Default:** `preserve`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `charset = utf-8`

```ini
charset = utf-8
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Value { get; set; }

    public int Double()
    {
        return Value * 2;
    }
}
```
:::

::::
